title: B-AP15 inhibited colon cancer cell proliferation by decreasing CDK6, Cyclin A, Cyclin E, c-Myc, and VEGF gene expression.
authors: Sophonnithiprasert, Thanet; Konjanthet, Sasiwan; Narinnork, Nattanicha; Prompat, Napat; Benjakul, Soottawat; Saetang, Jirakrit; Chimplee, Siriphorn; Mad-Adam, Nadeeya; Graidist, Potchanapond; Rattanaburee, Thidarath
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接筛选B-AP15的靶蛋白并验证其对结肠癌细胞基因表达的影响，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: This study evaluated the screening of novel possible target proteins of B-AP15 (NSC687852) in silico. Through in vitro investigation, the anticancer activity of B-AP15 was examined with respect to gene expression and cell proliferation of SW620 cells (colon cancer cells). Twenty proteins associated with colon cancer were selected to screen possible target proteins of B-AP15 using molecular docking. The binding position of B-AP15 and the top five candidate proteins were investigated using the Discovery Studio 2021 software program. Cytotoxicity, colonization ability, and cell inhibition were evaluated in SW620 cells for 24, 48, and 72 h via MTT assay, colony formation assay, and trypan blue assay. The gene expression was estimated using reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) at 48 h. B-AP15 showed higher binding to E2F8 (- 10.88 kcal/mol), Ras (- 10.86 kcal/mol), GSK3B (- 10.77 kcal/mol), CDK6 (- 10.75 kcal/mol), and Raf (- 10.12 kcal/mol) than to USP14 (- 7.83 kcal/mol) as a target protein of B-AP15. Interestingly, Ras, GSK3B, and CDK6 shared the binding position between B-AP15 and known inhibitors. The IC(50) values of B-AP15 against SW620 cells for 24, 48, and 72 h were 0.89 +/- 0.0019 microM, 1.38 +/- 0.16 microM, and 1.77 +/- 0.0016 microM, respectively. B-AP15 reduced cell viability and the size and number of colonies and increased cell inhibition in a time- and dose-dependent manner. CDK6, Cyclin A, and VEGF expression were inhibited at B-AP15 concentrations of 0.89 and 1.78 microM after treatment for 48 h. Cyclin E and cMyc expression were suppressed only at 1.78 microM. These results suggest that B-AP15 possesses cytotoxicity, reducing the size and number of colonies and increasing cell inhibition via suppression of CDK6, Cyclin A, Cyclin E c-Myc, and VEGF.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过计算机模拟评估了B-AP15（NSC687852）新型潜在靶蛋白的筛选。通过体外研究，检测了B-AP15对SW620细胞（结肠癌细胞）基因表达和细胞增殖的抗癌活性。选取20种与结肠癌相关的蛋白，利用分子对接 (molecular docking) 筛选B-AP15的潜在靶蛋白。使用Discovery Studio 2021软件程序研究了B-AP15与前五名候选蛋白的结合位置。通过MTT实验、集落形成实验和台盼蓝实验，在SW620细胞中评估了24、48和72小时的细胞毒性、集落形成能力和细胞抑制情况。在48小时时，使用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应 (reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction, RT-qPCR) 评估基因表达。B-AP15与E2F8（-10.88 kcal/mol）、Ras（-10.86 kcal/mol）、GSK3B（-10.77 kcal/mol）、CDK6（-10.75 kcal/mol）和Raf（-10.12 kcal/mol）的结合亲和力高于其靶蛋白USP14（-7.83 kcal/mol）。有趣的是，Ras、GSK3B和CDK6与B-AP15及已知抑制剂共享结合位置。B-AP15对SW620细胞在24、48和72小时的IC(50)值分别为0.89 ± 0.0019 μM、1.38 ± 0.16 μM和1.77 ± 0.0016 μM。B-AP15以时间和剂量依赖性方式降低细胞活力、集落大小和数量，并增加细胞抑制。在B-AP15浓度为0.89和1.78 μM处理48小时后，CDK6、Cyclin A和VEGF表达受到抑制。Cyclin E和cMyc表达仅在1.78 μM时被抑制。这些结果表明，B-AP15具有细胞毒性，通过抑制CDK6、Cyclin A、Cyclin E、c-Myc和VEGF来减少集落大小和数量，并增加细胞抑制。
